title: selliguea lanceola
intro: Selliguea lanceola, commonly known as the Lance-leaf Selliguea or the Lance-leaf Polyphlebion, is a type of plant species belonging to the Polypodiaceae family of ferns. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as fever, skin irritations, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea lanceola include its ability to reduce inflammation and pain, as well as its potential to aid in wound healing and skin regeneration. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
